QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` returns `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`, where `mbedtls_ct_zero` is a `volatile` global set to 0 in `library/constant_time.c`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the plain-C fallback XORs with the volatile global `mbedtls_ct_zero` (set to 0) and names that global. It places this under "Everywhere else", i.e. when assembly isn't used. It describes the fallback as a separate C path for `mbedtls_ct_bool`, `mbedtls_ct_uint_lt` and `mbedtls_ct_if`, so "the SAME function" is only implied, not stated outright.
